set.body:
Neuropublish (Stage 5 surface renditions) has to reject float64 GIFTI sources today. GiftiPayloadDecoder handles NIFTI_TYPE_FLOAT32, NIFTI_TYPE_INT32 and NIFTI_TYPE_UINT8; anything else parses as GiftiDataType.Other and fails with UnsupportedDataType. Real .surf.gii/.func.gii files with float64 coordinates or values exist (some MATLAB and older exporters), so neuropublish ingestion now refuses them with 'this revision reads float32 GIFTI sources only (write NIFTI_TYPE_FLOAT32)' and SPEC section 5 states the limit.

Asked for: GiftiDataType.Float64 (NIFTI_TYPE_FLOAT64), an 8-byte width in expectedByteCount, and decoding in doublePayload for ASCII and binary in both endians; the int paths may keep refusing it. Neuropublish would then drop its own float64 rejection for GIFTI.

Filed from neuropublish branch stage5/rendition-review-fixes.
set.title: GIFTI: support NIFTI_TYPE_FLOAT64 data arrays
